title: FINAL: independent ADR-0020 re-audit of the candidate SRD pack
description:
Perform the independent max-effort audit of the candidate after bounded automated gates
pass and before formal re-freeze. Adversarially inspect source fidelity/provenance,
discovery-supporting relationships, adjudication boundaries, selected capability correctness,
and state-integrity/runtime ownership as separate concerns. Automated green is entry evidence,
not universal completeness proof.
acceptance_criteria:
- Independent audit is performed against the exact candidate and current authority.
- Source fidelity, discovery, adjudication support, deterministic capability, and state integrity are reported separately.
- Known defect classes are attacked beyond original examples; any recurrence/new substantive defect blocks re-freeze and receives ownership.
- Unknown/unrecognized/unenumerable scope is reported as a limit, not a green result.
- A clean result means no blocker was found against the ADR-0020 truthfulness bar, not universal completeness.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: The final max-effort audit should use the compiler guide's dimensions explicitly: reproducibility, source completeness, structural fidelity, semantic modeling, runtime ownership/support, and end-to-end playable validation. Report them separately instead of collapsing them into a single 'represented somewhere' result.
